heading: Choose how you want to be billed.
description: One GexOptions plan gives you Swing ideas, intraday setup alerts, the dashboard, Scanner, options calculator, watchlist and export tools.
features: Swing ideas for 2–5 days and 1–3 weeks
Intraday wall tracking and in-app setup alerts
Scanner, options calculator and AI Export

faqs.a: The billing interval you selected begins after the trial unless you cancel before it ends.
Yes. You can open the Stripe billing portal from your account and cancel the subscription.

faqs.q: Do monthly and yearly include the same product?
faqs.a: Yes. They provide the same product access and differ only in billing interval and price.
No. GexOptions provides analytics and research tools. Trading decisions and risk remain yours.
